task: D9.9 Review list pages and review-success/review-failed routes use Manager API without legacy SQLite fallback
decision: Review lists are now manager-owned page reads. /api/dex/submissions/review, /review/<category>, /review-success and /review-failed call the Flask manager-only adapter, which calls /v1/reviews and maps Review Manager rows to the existing submission UI DTO. No legacy SQLite loader is reachable from these routes; manager unavailable returns 503 manager_read_failed and does not fall back. /v1/reviews now owns category/status/outcome filtering, pagination, category counts and page-scoped diagnostics/broadcast requests. The old SQLite-based review tests were converted into manager DTO contract fixtures so the old read path is no longer a production fallback.
fixtures: Review Manager classifies positive, non-positive, data_incomplete, not_executable and failed rows
Review Manager filters by category/status/outcome and paginates with page-scoped diagnostics/broadcast requests
Manager page adapter maps review rows to pair/path/createdAt/signedPnl/review summary fields
Review routes call review_manager_page_payload and never _load_submission_review_groups, _submission_record_api_payload or _submission_database_url
Manager unavailable returns 503 manager_read_failed without legacy SQLite fallback
Old SQLite review functional tests are replaced by manager DTO contract fixtures
knownBoundary: D9.9 covers review list reads only. Mainnet manager DB apply, Broadcast execution and production page cutover remain behind the planned M0-M8/P0 gates. The full test_architecture_guards.py file still reports six pre-existing unrelated failures in the current dirty worktree (broad exception audit, split package transitions, nested app_runtime/flashloan output directory, line-limit drift, and UI evidence JSON paths); the new migrated-review guard passes independently. No service restart, mainnet write, broadcast or destructive data operation was performed.
